items.summary: Recommendation: retain the deferred SEO, performance, UX, and monetization opportunities without queueing or requeueing. Existing failures require documented ownership, root cause, deterministic validation, rollback, deduplication, and measurement readiness first. Continue current repair-or-close work only.

Recommendation: approve containment-only execution. Retain evidence-backed SEO, performance, UX, monetization, and repository opportunities as deferred backlog; do not create or requeue implementation work this cycle. Continue existing repair-or-close, deterministic validation, rollback, deduplication, measurement, attribution, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Preserve private launch gates, parked-site dispositions, financial unknowns, and unsent external outreach.

Technical feasibility is not the blocker: deferred opportunities are individually reversible and implementable. Queue entry is unsafe until existing failure ownership, root cause, isolated deterministic validation, rollback, deduplication, and measurement readiness are documented. The authoritative candidate list is empty, so no new change request is justified.

Maintain the private launch gate and parked-site dispositions. Continue only the existing consolidated rights, data-flow, consent, vendor, retention, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and security evidence work. No public exposure, rights-dependent monetization, alert expansion, credential or configuration change, dependency addition, deployment, or external outreach is authorized.

Continue existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation only. Preserve aggregate commission as unattributed and retain revenue attribution, margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, budget capacity, and causal lift as unknown. Do not infer financial returns from traffic, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, performance scores, ordered items, or AI usage.

Continue the existing bounded security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Preserve private launch gates; do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue failures, or conduct external outreach.
